🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 6,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Talia Dubois and Talia Zhang will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Amara Nair and Dmitri Hassan and Rafael Marsh and Elena Okafor and Nora Weber and Andre Mendez will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Elena Garcia and Omar Vega will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
Something pads into the clearing — The Reunion. It's here.
🌅 THE HERALD FALLS. The realm exhales. That was the herald. The sky is still getting bigger.

"THE HERALD fell — the coalition's work, and the System had a camera on it. They faced The Big Beast and lived to sit here. They faced The Reunion and lived to sit here. 1 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
